description: Which items of the City of Toronto Basement Flooding Protection Subsidy Program apply to a home, which program conditions are met or need checking, and what to keep for the application. No dollar figures.

debts.description: Do you owe the City any taxes or debts?

downspouts.description: Are the eavestrough downspouts disconnected from the City sewer?

licence.description: Does the contractor who did or will do the work hold a valid City of Toronto business licence?

months_since.description: Months since the work was finished. Only for work already done. Optional. Unit: months.

paving.description: Do paved areas in the front yard, including parking pads, follow the City zoning by-law?

timing.description: When was or will the work be done?

work.description: Work you have done or plan to do. Comma separated.
